title: Rolls-Royce accelerates buyback, reaffirms 2026 guidance
summary: Investing.com -- Rolls-Royce Holdings on Thursday announced an accelerated £1.5 billion interim share buyback to be completed by February 25, 2027, as part of its existing £7 billion-£9 billion buyback program through 2028. The company reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance of £4.7 billion-£4.9 billion in underlying operating profit and £3.8 billion-£4.0 billion in free cash flow.
